scope: Reviewed public command and immutable 26.1 model references; actual target image prompts and write behavior require private acceptance.

reviewedSections: Authenticating One or More Intermediate Certificates

observations: The crypto RPC import/certificate leaf is type empty; PKCS12 fields carry URL/password and the enclosing output is a generic string. No inline public-DER payload transaction is established by this model.
The constrained SSH adapter authenticates one immediate CA on the existing CSR Trustpoint and then imports its public identity certificate. No key import or PKCS12 path is used.
Higher CA certificates require separate preprovisioned protected Trustpoints, exact DER and an explicit digest-to-Trustpoint mapping. No ancestor mutation is performed.
A second identity import can prompt for overwrite. The implementation refuses replacement/overwrite rather than confirming it.
Command examples are evidence for the bounded dialect, not acceptance of the actual 26.01.02 device. Exact prompts, chain lookup, NTP, ACLs, baseline TLS and recovery remain L-002.
